run.description: Each record goes through the same checks as one at a time; one that fails does not stop the others.
run.failed: The run stopped. Records already done stay done; run it again to do the rest.
run.error: Its progress could not be loaded.

item.skipped: skipped (not found, or not yours to change)

delete.description_one: It goes to the recycle bin, where it can be restored.
delete.description_other: They go to the recycle bin, where they can be restored.

restore.description_one: It comes back from the recycle bin.
restore.description_other: They come back from the recycle bin.

update.description_one: The change is applied to it.
update.description_other: The change is applied to each of them.
